note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All texts are fictional placeholders; jurisdiction unspecified. Only supplied relationships are drawn, with their supplied kind; a causal arrow appears only when a relationship is supplied as causal. Both readings are attributed and shown with equal weight.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Exploded view: hierarchy board and source book, the passage, the reading lens and the two readings; plain relations and one sequence link; the tracer runs book → passage → lens → A → lens → B with the lens as the focus.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a different fictional passage and readings; the author supplies a communication link from the board to the book and sequence links from the lens to each reading; the passage is the focus element and the tracer visits the board first and reading B before reading A.
